name: Agency trial sequences (marketing / web / SEO agencies selling to small businesses)
source: Copy v2 (docs/research/v2-leads-copy.md): plain text, no links in email 1, one reply CTA, four touches. No claim about the client beyond {oneLiner} / {proof}; no result promised.

problem-first.label: Problem first
problem-first.why: Most small businesses live on referrals while the website sits idle; names that, then one line on the offer, then an easy question.

touches.subject: @variant

touches.body:
{FirstName}, one more thought.

Sites that bring in little work are usually missing one or two simple things, not a whole rebuild.

Worth a short call to see what that would take for {Company}?

touches.subject: {Company} on Google
touches.body:
{FirstName}, a different angle.

When someone nearby searches for what you do, the top few results get most of the calls. It is worth knowing where {Company} shows up.

Want me to check and send you a short note on it?

{FirstName}, this is my last note so your inbox stays clear.

If {niche} comes up at {Company} later, a one-line reply here is all it takes.

Should I close the file for now?

question-led.label: Question led
question-led.why: Asks where their customers come from today; any answer opens a conversation.

touches.subject: @variant

touches.body:
{FirstName}, asking because the answer tells me quickly whether this is worth your time.

If referrals keep you busy, no need to change. If you want more of the work to come from search, that is what {ClientCompany} does.

Which is it at {Company}?

touches.subject: {Company} on Google
touches.body:
{FirstName}, one practical check.

Search for your main service plus your town and see where {Company} lands. Many {ICP} are surprised by what they find.

Want {ClientCompany} to run that check and send you the results?

{FirstName}, this is my last note so your inbox stays clear.

If {niche} comes up at {Company} later, a one-line reply here is all it takes.

Should I close the file for now?

quick-idea.label: Quick idea
quick-idea.why: One small idea they could use even without us (a page per service); the ask is to send an outline.

touches.subject: @variant

touches.body:
{FirstName}, pages like that are quick to write and easy to put off.

{ClientCompany} can draft them with you.

Would that be useful for {Company}?

touches.subject: reviews at {Company}
touches.body:
{FirstName}, a second idea.

A short text after each job asking for a Google review tends to lift the count quickly. More reviews help you show up higher.

Open to {ClientCompany} setting that up for {Company}?

{FirstName}, this is my last note so your inbox stays clear.

If {niche} comes up at {Company} later, a one-line reply here is all it takes.

Should I close the file for now?

local-proof.why: Leads with one true proof line the client gave us; used only when the profile has one.
